_note: Rules for banned_terms.py. 'banned' and 'unsafe_claims' block a release; 'hype' warns. Every entry states why, so a reviewer can judge a false positive instead of guessing. Keep this in step with the project memory file product-naming-trademark-bans.md.

banned_terms.why: WHEEL OF LIFE is a live US registration (Reg. 3918518, Success Motivation International) covering printed personal-development and goal-setting materials - our exact goods. Use 'The Balance Audit'.
Abbreviation of Getting Things Done, a registered method name.
Tiago Forte's method name (Building a Second Brain).
Tiago Forte's book and course name.
Reads as Building a Second Brain; pick our own mechanism name.
Brian Moran's registered book and system name.
James Clear's book title; do not borrow it for habit pages.
Loaded social-media aesthetic the brand explicitly rejects.
Name it ourselves - the grid is fine, the borrowed label is not our brand voice.
Dropped on the conflict screen: crowded on Etsy/Gumroad and the name of an ACT therapy worksheet. Use 'The Compass System'.
Rejected brand name: three live users including The 1% Planner, a direct category neighbour.

unsafe_claims.why: Promises to treat a medical or mental-health condition. We sell reflection tools, not treatment.

unsafe_claims.pattern: (diagnos\w+|assess whether you|find out if you('re| are))\s*(have|are|suffer|burnt|burned)?
unsafe_claims.why: Implies clinical assessment. Brand rule: a structured self-reflection tool, never a diagnosis.
Clinical framing outside the disclaimer. The words are allowed only inside the 'not therapy' disclaimer itself.
A research claim we cannot cite. The pipeline forbids numbers or studies that are not in the evidence files.
A statistic with no source. Never put performance percentages in product copy.
Money and legal pages must say 'educational only - not financial advice', never give it.
Off-brand and risky; this is the competitor anti-model the brand kit calls out.
A refund or outcome guarantee is an owner decision that is still open (plan Q5). It must not appear inside a product file.

hype.why: Brand voice is calm, specific, kind-but-firm. Say what the buyer does in twenty minutes instead.
The explicit anti-model in the brand kit. We do not shame the buyer.

hype.pattern: limited time|act now|only today|hurry|don't miss out
hype.why: Brand rule: no urgency that never actually expires.
Generic hype language; replace with the concrete thing the page does.
The word is fine in prose, but the standard four-circle ikigai Venn is banned as borrowed and over-copied. Check the page's diagram.
The method asks for real effort; promising ease undercuts the product and the voice.

reflection.example: A structured self-reflection tool. Not therapy, diagnosis or financial advice.
